request: Add the missing ARM32 time64 kernel support while preserving the existing ASUS/Broadcom time32 ABI.
deployed_firmware: Kernel9-ui1 boots on the physical GT-BE19000AI BCM6813 in slot1. Bounded service and time64 acceptance passed. Slot1 remains uncommitted and the next reboot selects original slot2; SL1680 is unchanged.

patch.ordered_stack_check: 7/7 patches across 142 files; exact unwind to pinned source HEAD passed

disabled_by_existing_config.io_pgetevents_time64: CONFIG_AIO=n: ENOSYS remains intentional; handler independently compile-tested with CONFIG_AIO=1 without changing candidate configuration

implementation.padding: Compat nanosecond high word is ignored; native64 invalid high bits still rejected. Shared futex reads through get_timespec64.
implementation.legacy_time32: Old entry points and compat layouts remain; CONFIG_COMPAT_32BIT_TIME=y and COMPAT_USE_64BIT_TIME=0 retained.

validation.time64: Raw arm64, armel, armhf pass; armel and armhf actual BE98 glibc2.44 time_t64 positive future timer, interrupted sleeps, pselect/ppoll remaining timeout and signal-mask restoration, futex STOP/CONT restart, and 2100 VM clock roundtrip pass.
validation.nested_layouts: Ready fd sets and sigarg guard pages, pending high RT63 signal mask, compat siginfo, recvmmsg message/iovec/SCM_RIGHTS, POSIX timers, message queues and semaphores pass.
validation.legacy: ARM32 time32 clock and timerfd canary/roundtrip tests pass.
validation.CRC_limitation: CONFIG_MODVERSIONS=n; no ELF CRC symbols, so CRC comparison is not used as proof.
validation.existing_modules: Kernel8 module fixture retained; Tuxera tfat/tntfs/thfsplus and RAID/Btrfs/exportfs/Overlay modules loaded successfully in Docker regression. No module source/config or module artifact changes are required for this syscall-only patch.

metadata_guard_qemu.label: kernel9-ui1-trial-guard
metadata_guard_qemu.qemu_disk_override_only: loop.max_part=8 be19000ai_trial_disk=loop0; not a hardware boot parameter

boundaries: Physical acceptance is bounded: successful new boot, exact live file hashes, enabled time64 probes and observed core services do not establish long-term stability, every SSID/client or throughput.
Kernel8 modules and integrated web/RGB/history/CCR code are retained. Only two rootfs release identity files change; stock PID 1, libcodb, loader and libc remain unchanged.
Isolated temporary glibc runtimes were used for hardware probes, then removed. No stock glibc/loader installation or SL1680 board change is included; no test set or adjusted the global clock.
The new syscall ABI is not a claim that all legacy 32-bit socket timestamp options, ioctls or filesystem formats are Y2038 safe.
AIO stays disabled; compile-only review is not AIO runtime validation.
QEMU cannot prove board-specific Wi-Fi, Runner or vendor hardware behavior.
Slot1 remains uncommitted; next reboot selects original slot2. No permanent boot-slot commit was performed.

initial_harness_attempts.resolution: Corrected VM epoch-zero fixture assumption and invalid-clock test ID; kernel image unchanged.
Reran with the actual QEMU_DOCKER_MEMCG_COMPLETE marker; kernel and initramfs unchanged.
